blurb.A1: Single words and set phrases. Yori starts with pronunciation and first sentences.
blurb.A2: You build simple sentences about daily life and weekends. Tenses and politeness are still shaky.
blurb.B1: You tell coherent stories and correct yourself. Next up: connectors and nuance.
blurb.B2: You discuss fluently. Next up: register, idioms and written style.
